##my beautiful bar graph
```{r}
vector1 = c(1,3,5,7,9,12,15)
library(RColorBrewer)
coul <- brewer.pal(5,"Set2")
barplot(height = vector1,
        names.arg = c("A","B","C","D","E", "F", "G"),
        col = coul)
```
